story_type: Coast Guard K9 and handler ride a helicopter hoist to a moving boat (training)
hook: A Coast Guard dog, hanging under a helicopter over open water.
narration: This dog is hanging under a Coast Guard helicopter, clipped to its handler.
Coast Guard K9s Simba and Lani work out of Houston with their handlers.
In May 2022, off Galveston, Texas, they practiced riding a hoist from a helicopter down to a moving boat.
The helicopter holds a hover over the boat while the hoist operator lowers the cable, until boots and paws touch the deck.
Then the team clips back in and rides the cable up again.
[short pause] The point is speed. These drills get a dog and handler ready to reach vessels out on the water fast.
outcome: Each dog and handler rode the cable down and landed back on the deck of the boat.
title: Coast Guard dog rides a helicopter hoist
description:
Coast Guard Marine Safety and Security Team Houston K9s Simba and Lani and their handlers practice helicopter-to-boat hoists off Galveston, Texas, on May 18, 2022.
